originalTitle: World's oldest president reshuffles army as his absence stokes unease
title: A Special Story from Cameroon: Our President is Away!
content:
Hello, Young Adventurers!

Hello everyone! It's me, your friendly news reporter from Africa, ready to share a special story with you. Today, we're flying all the way to a beautiful country called Cameroon. Imagine a place with green forests, sunny beaches, and lots of friendly people. That's Cameroon! It's a country in the middle of Africa, and it's a very important place.

Who is the President?

Every country has a leader, just like your school has a principal, or your family has a grown-up in charge. In Cameroon, the leader is called the President. His name is President Paul Biya. He is a very, very important person. His job is to help all the people of Cameroon, to make sure everyone is safe, happy, and that the country works well. Did you know? President Paul Biya is one of the oldest presidents in the whole wide world! He has been the leader of Cameroon for a very, very long time. That means he has lots of experience helping his country grow.

Where Has President Biya Been?

Now, here's the news part. For about two whole months, President Biya has been away from his important office. Can you imagine your principal being away from school for two whole months? People might start wondering, 'Where did they go? Are they okay?' That's exactly what has been happening in Cameroon. People in the country, and even people in other countries, have been asking: 'Where is President Biya? Why hasn't he been at work?' It's like when your favourite teacher isn't in class for a long time, and you start to miss them and wonder where they are.

Whispers and Worries

When someone important is away for a long time, and nobody says exactly why, people start to guess. These guesses are sometimes called 'rumours' or 'whispers'. Imagine if your friends started whispering about why someone wasn't at the playground. That's a bit like what happens with news. Some people have been whispering that maybe President Biya wasn't feeling very well. They worried about his health. 'Health' means if you are strong and feeling good, or if you are feeling a bit sick. Because he is very old, some people naturally worried if he was okay. Did you know? It's normal for people to worry about their leaders, especially if they are away for a long time. Leaders help keep things calm and steady in a country, like a strong tree in a forest.

What Does His Team Say?

But guess what? President Biya's special team, his helpers and friends who work with him, have said something important. They said, 'Don't worry! President Biya is doing just fine!' They told everyone that the president is healthy and well. They said he is just taking some time, perhaps on a break, and that everything is okay. It's like when your parents tell you, 'Everything is alright, don't worry!' His team wants everyone in Cameroon to feel calm and know that their leader is okay, even if he's not right there in his office every day.

Why is a President's Presence Important?

You might be thinking, 'Why does it matter so much if a president is away?' Well, a president has a very, very big job. They are like the captain of a big ship, making sure it sails smoothly through the ocean. When the captain is on the ship, everyone feels more confident and knows what to do. When a president is at work, people feel safe and sure that decisions are being made. They know who is in charge. When the president is away for a long time, even if his team says he is well, people can sometimes start to feel a little bit 'uneasy'. That means they feel a little worried or unsure about things. Did you know? A president's job is to make big decisions for the whole country, like building schools, making sure there is enough food, and keeping everyone safe. It's a tough job!

Changes in the Army

Something else interesting happened while the president was away. The 'army' is a group of very brave people who protect the country. Like special guards! Sometimes, a leader might want to make some changes to who is in charge of different parts of the army. Even though President Biya was away, some news came out that he had made some important changes. He moved some people to new jobs in the army. This shows that even if he's not in his office, he can still make important decisions for his country. It's like a principal making decisions about your school from home if they are on holiday. Did you know? The army helps keep peace and protects the country from any dangers. They are very important for a country's safety.

Helping Cameroon Grow

Cameroon is a wonderful country. It has beautiful animals like elephants and gorillas in its national parks. It has delicious food, and people speak different languages like French and English, as well as many local languages! Everyone in Cameroon wants their country to be strong and happy. When a leader is away, it's a good reminder that everyone has a part to play in helping their community. We can all be kind to each other, help our friends, and make our part of the world a happy place. Did you know? Cameroon is sometimes called 'Africa in miniature' because it has so many different landscapes and cultures, just like a little version of the whole continent!

What's Next?

So, the big news is that President Biya of Cameroon has been away, people have been wondering about him, but his team says he is fine. He even made some changes in the army from afar! We hope that President Biya is indeed well, and that he will be back in his office soon, helping Cameroon continue to be a strong and happy country. It's important for leaders to be there, guiding their people. We send our best wishes to President Biya and all the lovely people of Cameroon!
summary: President Biya of Cameroon has been away from his big job for two months, making people wonder if he's okay, but his helpers say he is fine and even made some changes for the country's army.
whyMatters: This is important because when a country's leader is away for a long time, people can feel a little worried about who is making big choices to keep everyone safe and happy.

originalTitle: Deadly landslide hits Ethiopia mountain monastery during prayer service
title: Sad News from Ethiopia: A Mountain Moved!
content:
Hello, Friends!

Hi everyone! It's your kid-friendly news reporter from Africa here. Today, I have some sad news to share with you from a beautiful country called Ethiopia. Sometimes, big natural things happen that can make us feel a little bit worried or sad. But it's important to understand what happened and how people are helping each other. Let's learn together.

What is a Landslide?

Have you ever built a sandcastle at the beach, and then splashed water on it, and it all fell down? Well, a landslide is a bit like that, but much, much bigger! A landslide is when a lot of earth, rocks, and mud suddenly slide down a mountain or a hill. Imagine a giant slide made of dirt and stones! **Did you know?** Heavy rain can make the ground very soft and heavy. When the ground gets too wet and heavy, it can't hold on to the mountain anymore, and it starts to slide! This is why landslides often happen after a lot of rain. When rocks and soil move this much, it can be very dangerous. They can move very fast, like a rushing river of earth. People who live near mountains sometimes need to be careful, especially when it rains a lot. It's a powerful force of nature.

Where Did This Happen?

This sad event happened in Ethiopia. Ethiopia is a big, beautiful country in Eastern Africa, with a lot of friendly people. It has tall mountains, wide rivers, and ancient stories. People in Ethiopia are very kind and have a rich culture that is thousands of years old. The place where the landslide happened was a very special spot. It was a monastery. Can you say "mon-uh-stair-ee"? A monastery is a place where holy people live, pray, and think quietly. They often build these special places in peaceful, beautiful spots, sometimes high up in the mountains. This monastery was built right into the side of a mountain. It had been there for a very, very long time! People loved visiting it for its peace and history. **Did you know?** Ethiopia is one of the oldest countries in the world! It has never been colonized by another country, which is very unique and makes its history even more special.

The Monastery on the Mountain

This particular monastery was a peaceful place, high up in the mountains. Imagine waking up every day to see amazing views of other mountains and deep valleys. People would go there to pray and feel close to their faith. The monastery had buildings and even caves where people lived and prayed. It was a very old place, filled with history and stories passed down through many generations. Many people loved to visit this monastery because it was so special. They felt it was a sacred place, a place to feel peaceful and connected to God. **Did you know?** Some monasteries in Ethiopia are so old that they were built hundreds of years ago! They are like living museums of history and faith. People would often stay overnight at the monastery to attend special prayer services. A prayer service is a time when people gather to pray, sing, and listen to holy teachings. It's a very important part of their faith and community life.

What Happened That Night?

The sad part of our story happened during one of these special prayer services. It was nighttime, and many people were gathered at the monastery, praying peacefully. It was a quiet and holy time for them. Suddenly, without warning, the mountain side where the monastery was built started to move. The earth and big rocks began to crash down. This was the landslide we talked about. It was a very big slide of rocks and soil, moving with great force. The landslide hit the monastery right where people were praying. It was a very scary and sad moment for everyone there. The rocks and earth came crashing down on the buildings and caves where people were. **Did you know?** Mountains can look very strong and still, but sometimes, after a lot of rain or other natural events, parts of them can become loose and move. It's like a giant puzzle piece coming unstuck. Many people were hurt, and sadly, some people lost their lives because of the falling rocks and earth. It was a very, very sad day for the community and for all of Ethiopia. Hearts were heavy with sorrow.

Helping Hands

When something sad like this happens, people always come together to help. Brave people, like emergency workers and volunteers, quickly went to the monastery. They worked very hard, day and night, to find people and help those who were hurt. They used their hands, special tools, and even trained dogs to search through the fallen rocks and earth. It was a very difficult and dangerous job, but they didn't give up. They wanted to help everyone they could, showing incredible courage and kindness. People from all over Ethiopia and even other parts of Africa sent their love and support. When we see people helping each other after a sad event, it shows how strong and kind human hearts can be. It reminds us that we are all one big family, ready to support each other. **Did you know?** Rescue workers are very brave people who help others in dangerous situations. They often train very hard to be ready for emergencies like this, practicing how to find and help people safely.

Staying Safe Near Mountains

This sad story reminds us about being careful when we live near mountains. Sometimes, nature can be unpredictable. If you ever live near a mountain or a big hill, especially during very heavy rain, it's good to listen to what grown-ups and local leaders say. They might tell you if an area is not safe, or if you need to move to a safer place for a little while. This is to keep everyone safe and sound. Trees and plants on mountains can help hold the soil together with their roots, but sometimes even that is not enough when there is too much rain. **Did you know?** Planting trees on hillsides can help prevent landslides because the roots of the trees act like natural glue, holding the soil in place! They are like tiny superheroes for the mountain. It's also important to remember that while nature can sometimes be scary, it is also very beautiful and gives us so much. We learn from these events and try to be smarter and safer in the future, respecting the power of our planet.

Our Thoughts Are With Ethiopia

So, that's the sad news from Ethiopia. Our hearts go out to all the people who were at the monastery, and to their families and friends. We send them our love and hope that they can heal and find peace after such a difficult time. It's a reminder that even in beautiful places, sometimes unexpected things can happen. But it also shows us how people care for each other, how they help, and how they come together when times are tough. We stand with our friends in Ethiopia, sending them strength and comfort. Thank you for listening, friends. Keep being kind to each other!
summary: A mountain in Ethiopia moved, causing a sad landslide at an old monastery where people were praying, but many kind people are helping those affected.
whyMatters: This is important because it shows how nature can sometimes be powerful, reminds us to be safe, and highlights how people help each other when sad things happen in our big African family.
